messages: Hi Jiashu, Alex here! Excited to connect and chat!
Hey nice to meet you
I'm really interested in music and I would love to meet someone to play together.
Cool what instruments do you play? I play bass.
I love singing and I also know how to play keyboard.
That's cool what kind of music style are you interested?
I generally love pop and rock music. My favorite band is One Ok Rock.
That's something I haven't heard of.
I think they are pretty popular in both Japan and US
Can you recommend some songs?
I like the song Wherever you are
Are you able to sing it? That guy has a wild voice.
I am not sure. I can try though.
Jiashu, trying those vocals? Alex, as a music producer and radio host, you guys need to jam or get this on air!
Hi Bar! yeah I'm down to get a new gym buddy
Awesome! Where do you gym usually?
I usually hit Payne Whitney! What about you, future spotter?
Love that energy! Sounds like you're already figuring out the spot to crush some weights. Get ready to spot each other! 💪

Awesome! Sounds like you're both ready to get moving. How about checking out Powerhouse Gym or City Climb Gym? Both are fantastic spots to meet up and crush some fitness goals!
